paper_title: IterCAD: An Iterative Multimodal Agent for Visually-Grounded CAD Generation and Editing
different_same_named_work_not_used: 2608.24020: Iterative Program Repair for CAD Code Generation from Orthographic Views
preserved: Official fixed TOP/FRONT/RIGHT/ISO renderer, including overall dimensions and radii
adaptations: CADGenBench generation images mapped to native gt_view_path reference-image field; no GT shape is supplied
CADGenBench textual request appended once to the native initial request; official system prompt and feedback loop retained
Multiple source pages use a contact sheet without page resizing
STEP and exact executed code captured from the same native execution object; no reexecution for export
Optional Responses API bridge converts the same complete visible text/image history; native ChatCompletions remains the default
Responses bridge omits temperature by default for reasoning-model compatibility and records the sampling difference

Without GT CD, prioritize an attempt containing executed code and terminating in exec_success or done_by_model over a last-successful-code fallback; within the same completion class retain unchanged official compare_results and its earlier-attempt tie rule
Final geometric evaluation uses separate CADGenBench evaluator and retains physical scale

no_gt_attempt_selection.reason: Upstream extract_successful_final_cd recognizes terminal success but requires CD; without GT both a complete attempt and a failed-last-turn fallback otherwise return no CD and tie

reproduction_boundary: Using GPT-5.6 Sol or another model preserves the native inference protocol but does not reproduce IterCAD SFT/RL weights or its reported benchmark numbers.
